LeT terrorist Yasir killed in Jammu and Kashmir encounter

Jammu and Kashmir Police identified a Pakistani Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) terrorist, named Yasir, who was killed in an encounter in Budgam district on Friday. The encounter, codenamed Operation Ashdar, took place in the Ashdar Gali area. The joint operation involved the Indian Army, Jammu and Kashmir Police, and the Central Reserve Police Force. Police stated Yasir was a resident of Pakistan.
